response.text:
I can do that — but because this will remove/modify email I need your confirmation and a couple quick decisions first.

Recommended (safe) plan — please confirm or edit:
- Target: All messages with the label "Newsletters".
- Scope: messages older than 12 months (i.e., before 2025-09-05).
- Exceptions: keep any messages that are starred or currently unread.
- Operation (default): move those messages to Trash (recoverable for ~30 days unless you permanently empty Trash).
- Consequence: messages will no longer appear under Newsletters; they will be moved to Trash and can be restored from Trash for ~30 days. After that they will be permanently deleted by Gmail.

Options you can choose instead
- Cutoff: change to a different cutoff (e.g., 18 months, 2 years, or a specific date).
- Exceptions: also keep messages with attachments, from specific senders, or marked Important.
- Operation: instead of Trash, I can (a) archive them (keeps them in All Mail), (b) remove the Newsletters label only, or (c) permanently delete immediately (not recommended).
- Preview: I can show a short sample (up to 10 messages: sender + subject + date) before taking action.

Please reply with one of:
1) “Yes — proceed with the recommended plan.” (I will then perform the Trash action.)
2) “Proceed but change X” (specify cutoff, exceptions, or operation).
3) “Show a preview first.”
4) Or give other instructions.

Once you confirm exactly which option you want, I’ll proceed.
